prerequisites.softmax_recap: A softmax probability vector has nonnegative entries whose sum is 1.
prerequisites.embedding_to_logits_to_softmax_public_le: Prior public lesson 3ERAcHlJeGo, Oct 9; recap only, no remake.
prerequisites.learning_objective: A one-position loss function maps the target probability to a numeric penalty. Training optimizes loss across examples; optimization is deferred to the next lesson.
prerequisites.prediction: A prediction is the selected probability distribution over candidate next tokens.
prerequisites.transfer: Transfer means applying the same rule to a new target probability.

primary_example.natural_log_definition: exp(x)=e^x; ln is its inverse: ln(exp(x))=x. ln(1)=0; for 0<p<1, ln(p)<0, so -ln(p)>0.

monotonicity.claim: A smaller positive target probability produces a larger loss.

validation_contract.zero_probability_implementation: reject clearly rather than return infinity
validation_contract.invalid_target_id: reject when target ID is outside the vector

boundary: Hand-set toy probabilities only. No training, gradient, autograd, framework, Transformer inference, or claim of semantic understanding.
